rationale: Round 2 shows clearer parameter-setting and quantified language, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and Lower Saxony still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still require durable capacity and cost cuts that may include them. The discussion is circling the same red lines with little movement, so an external intervention to narrow options or impose a structured bargaining framework is more appropriate than simple continuation.
